regulatory_and_risk_profile: Brand safety and public hallucination liability
Consumer privacy obligations (CCPA, GDPR) for customer data
Extreme peak seasonality (BFCM and holiday traffic spikes)
paper_process_blockers: PCI-DSS scope review before any payment-adjacent flow goes live
Privacy review of customer data flows
Annual budget cycle that locks seasonal support capacity
dominant_friction: A brand failure can go viral in an afternoon, and seasonal spikes make variable costs swing sharply.
value_frame: Anchor on conversion lift, brand-safe guardrails, elastic outcome-based pricing during seasonal spikes, and a 14-day time to value.

buying_committee.primary_fear: An AI agent hallucinates unauthorized discounts or off-brand messaging in public.
The launch misses the holiday window.
We pay for shelfware seats or unmeasured pilot sprawl.
Runaway variable usage bills during Q4 holiday surges.

signature_objections: Our seasonal volume jumps 6x in November. How do we cap runaway token or action spend?
If your agent promises a customer a refund outside policy, who eats the brand and financial hit?
We already have 12 legacy POS and loyalty systems. Why won't this take 18 months to integrate?

metrics.speaker: VP Digital / E-Commerce
metrics.partial: We watch conversion every week, but the agent's impact is not separated out yet.
metrics.verbatim: We need the agent to lift conversion by at least 1.5 points on assisted sessions and cut cost per resolution by a third before the holiday peak.

economic_buyer.speaker: CMO
economic_buyer.partial: The digital budget is mine, but finance has a say on anything variable.
economic_buyer.verbatim: I own the digital budget and can sign a pilot up to the cap. The CFO must approve any seasonal commitment above it.

decision_criteria.speaker: CMO
decision_criteria.partial: Brand safety matters more to me than anything else on this list.
decision_criteria.verbatim: Any agent that can offer a discount must follow a published policy with hard limits, and it has to pass our brand-safety test suite.

decision_process.speaker: CMO
decision_process.partial: Brand review comes first, then the budget cycle, and the timing is tight before November.
decision_process.verbatim: Brand review, then privacy review, then the CFO on seasonal spend. We need the budget locked by the end of September for the holiday season.

paper_process.speaker: CFO
paper_process.partial: Payment-adjacent flows get a PCI scope review, and we are sensitive about that.
paper_process.verbatim: Anything touching the payment flow goes through PCI scope review first, and that review alone takes about six weeks.

identify_pain.speaker: VP Digital / E-Commerce
identify_pain.partial: Holiday volume overwhelms the contact center every year, and we pay for it.
identify_pain.verbatim: Last holiday we paid for an emergency BPO surge at double rate and still missed our CSAT target by eight points.

champion.speaker: VP Digital / E-Commerce
champion.partial: I like the conversion angle, and I will back it internally.
champion.verbatim: I will champion this in the Monday growth review myself, and I need a pilot scoped to the holiday peak with clear exit gates.

competition.speaker: CFO
competition.partial: Our commerce platform has its own assistant that we already pay for.
competition.verbatim: The commerce platform's bundled assistant comes with our renewal, so you must prove incremental lift over what we already have.
